automation.title: Let your career advance on its own
automation.description: Apply automatically to the best openings with 1 click and increase your chances of landing your next professional challenge. Your CV is sent to dozens of perfectly matched opportunities while you prepare for what comes next.

resume.title: Your perfect resume, ready in under a minute
resume.description: Impress recruiters effortlessly with our intuitive builder. Professional templates, smart suggestions, and instant formatting — your winning CV is just seconds away.

tailored.title: Each job deserves a resume that speaks the recruiter's language
tailored.description: Our AI analyzes each opportunity and automatically adapts your CV to highlight exactly what that specific recruiter is looking for. Same you, perfect presentation.

ats.title: Know before you send: pass or fail?
ats.description: Don't waste applications. Our ATS analyzer scans your CV the same way recruiting systems do, giving you instant feedback and actionable improvements.

swipe.title: Find jobs you'll love — the fun way
swipe.subtitle: Swipe through opportunities like never before. Job hunting doesn't have to be boring.
swipe.tinderDescription: Choose opportunities with a touch. Fun, fast, and intelligent. Swipe right to apply instantly, left to skip. Your next dream job is just a swipe away.
swipe.matchDescription: Discover where your talent truly shines. See your compatibility with every job before you apply. No more wasted applications.

gamification.title: Level up your career with every application
gamification.subtitle: Feel your real growth. Track your progress, earn achievements, and stay motivated throughout your job search journey.

social.title: Join thousands who already transformed their careers
